source: Issue #838 generality G1 IC-15 (a): a Verify step whose repair rewrites a model-written verifier passes only when the host's deterministic oracle also passes (2026-10-24)

cli_q.fixed_verifier:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
result = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, os.path.join(HERE, "src", "csv_stats", "main.py"), os.path.join(HERE, "fixture.csv")],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
)
rows = {line.split()[0]: line.split() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()}
price = rows.get("price", [])
qty = rows.get("qty", [])
ok = (
    result.returncode == 0
    and price[1:2] == ["350"]
    and price[-2:] == ["150", "80"]
    and qty[1:2] == ["10"]
    and qty[-2:] == ["5", "2"]
)
print("PASS" if ok else "FAIL: unexpected table")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
